summary_md: **Cordoval ([@CordovalAIOffic](https://x.com/CordovalAIOffic/status/2116486236240216475))** introduces **Inkwell-1**, an Apache-2.0 website-generation model with GGUF builds for Ollama and LM Studio, trained only on the 2,180 of 4,000 generated sites that passed headless-browser checks for responsiveness, accessibility, AA contrast and JS errors ([cordoval-inkwell-1](https://huggingface.co/kierendaystudios/cordoval-inkwell-1)).
relevance: Small local web-design model with verified training data.
